DESCRIPTION: Four stdio lifecycle failures in the MCP Python SDK 2.2.0, measured wit

claims.text: A stdio MCP server that never exits is not a mystery: the Python SDK's writer task can be blocked in a pipe write that only the reader can unblock, so cancelling it waits forever. In MCP Python SDK 2.

review_limitations: The 64 KiB figure is the documented Linux default (16 pages x 4096 bytes). pipe(7) warns that applications should not rely on a particular capacity and that since Linux 4.5 the default can be lower when the pipe-user-pages-soft limit is exceeded; the article's limits section covers non-Linux platforms but not that exception.
